title: tools/closeout.sh: mechanical closeout scripted out, AI tool calls ~15→5; pattern reusable across spokes
signal: Implemented tools/closeout.sh covering all mechanical closeout steps: version bump, session_count++, timestamps, lug archival (in_progress→completed), WAI-LugIndex.jsonl regen, score_backlog.py --update-state. Script is idempotent, has --dry-run flag, prints human-readable summary. wai-closeout.md Steps 4+5 now call the script instead of instructing the AI to do manual file edits. Reduces AI closeout tool calls from ~15 to ~5.
rationale: Every spoke performs closeout. Scripting the mechanical steps saves ~10 AI tool calls per session. Script pattern reusable: each spoke can adopt tools/closeout.sh via teaching. AI focus on semantic work only: signals, next_rec, hub routing.
